title: Privacy policy
summary: What Exia Organics collects when you browse or order, why, who sees it, and your rights under Ghana’s Data Protection Act.
body:
This policy explains what Exia Organics ("we", "us") learns about you when you visit this website or order from us, why, who else sees it, and the choices you have. We have written it in plain language and kept it to what this website actually does.

We follow Ghana's Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).

## The short version

- You don't need an account to shop with us, and we don't run advertising trackers or analytics on this website.
- When you order, we ask for the details we need to deliver and to match your Mobile Money payment: your name, phone number, delivery address and MoMo transaction ID.
- We use those details to fulfil your order and look after you afterwards. We never sell them.
- You can ask us to see, correct or delete your details at any time: email {email} or call {phone}.

## What we collect

**When you place an order** at checkout, we collect:

- your name and phone number
- your delivery area and address (street, house or landmark)
- the Mobile Money transaction ID and the name on the sending MoMo account, so we can find your payment
- the products, quantities and total in your order, and any note you add
- the order reference we create for you (it starts with EXA-)

**When you message us** on WhatsApp, by phone or by email, we receive whatever you choose to share, along with your number or address.

**When you browse**, our website host automatically receives the technical information every website receives: your IP address, browser type and the pages you request. This is used to deliver the site and keep it secure, not to build a profile of you.

We don't ask for, and you should never send us, your MoMo PIN. We will never ask for it.

## What we use it for

- to confirm your payment, prepare your order and deliver it
- to contact you about your order, by phone or WhatsApp
- to answer your questions and handle any problem with an order
- to keep the business and tax records Ghanaian law requires
- to keep the website working and secure

We only send you promotional messages if you have asked us to, and you can ask us to stop at any time.

## Who we share it with

We only share what each of them needs:

- **Delivery riders and couriers** receive your name, phone number and delivery address so they can bring your order.
- **Netlify**, our website host, stores the order form you submit and sends it to us. Their servers may be outside Ghana.
- **WhatsApp (Meta)** carries any messages you choose to send us there, under WhatsApp's own privacy policy.
- **Your Mobile Money provider** processes your payment. We never see your MoMo PIN or account balance.
- **Google Fonts** supplies the lettering on this website, so your browser contacts Google to load it.
- **YouTube** plays tutorial videos when you press play. We use YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode, so no YouTube cookies are set until you start a video.

We may also share information when the law requires it, or to protect our customers or our business from fraud.

## What's saved in your browser

This website doesn't set cookies. It saves a few small items in your own browser so the site works as you'd expect:

- **your cart**, so it's still there when you come back
- **your current order reference**, until you place the order
- **whether you've seen the welcome screen, closed an announcement or closed a promotion**, so we don't keep showing them

These stay on your device. We can't see them, and you can clear them at any time in your browser settings.

## How long we keep it

We keep order details for as long as we need them to deliver your order and look after you afterwards, and then for as long as Ghanaian tax and accounting rules require us to keep business records. Messages are kept only as long as they are useful for your order or question. After that, we delete them.

## Keeping it safe

This website is served over a secure, encrypted connection (HTTPS). Only the people who run Exia Organics can see your orders, and we limit what we share as described above. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable care to protect your details.

## Your rights

Under the Data Protection Act, you can ask us to:

- tell you what information we hold about you, and give you a copy
- correct anything that is wrong or out of date
- delete your information, unless we have to keep it by law
- stop using your information for a purpose you object to, including marketing messages

Email {email} or call {phone} ({hours}). We'll reply as soon as we can. If you're unhappy with how we handle your information, you can also complain to Ghana's Data Protection Commission.

## Children

Our shop is for adults. If you're under 18, please ask a parent or guardian to order for you. If you believe a child has given us their details, contact us and we'll delete them.

## Changes to this policy

If we change how we use your information, we'll update this page and the date at the top. Please check back from time to time.
